prompt: A memory created by Developer A in Repository X — can Developer B access it in Repository X?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, Copilot Memory is repository-scoped. All permitted users in a repo share its memories. Memories cannot cross repository boundaries.

options.text: Yes — memories are repository-scoped; all permitted Copilot users in that repo benefit from memories created there
Yes — memories are org-scoped across all repos
No — memories expire at the end of the creating user's session
